name: Luscombe 11 Sedan
summary: Four-seat postwar Luscombe designed for flying farmers, then upgraded for businessmen. A larger high-wing sibling of the Silvaire.

wings: High wing braced by struts on each side
engines: Single Continental flat-six in a rounded cowl
fuselage: Four-seat cabin with large windows all round
tail: Conventional fin and rudder with a low horizontal tail

tellTales: Four-seat strut-braced high-wing tailwheel with a roomy cabin
Larger, boxier cabin than a two-seat postwar tourer
Rounded cowl on a deep fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The Luscombe 8 is the smaller two-seat sibling; the Sedan has a much bigger four-seat cabin.
The 170 has a swept-back fin and flat spring-steel gear; the Sedan has a different, rounder tail and a deeper cabin.
The 108 has a curved, tall fin and a longer cowl; the Sedan has a squarer cabin and a different tail.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
